title: Build shopping-list edit item sheet with aisle reassignment
description: Replace the current edit-item alert flow with a sheet-based editor that mirrors AddItemSheet, pre-fills item text and aisle, auto-focuses the text field, disables Save for empty trimmed input, and performs the correct update vs remove-and-add mutation flow before persisting markdown.
acceptance_criteria: Swipe-to-Edit presents a sheet with text field and aisle picker instead of a one-field alert.
The edit sheet pre-fills the current item text and current aisle from the document.
The text field auto-focuses when the sheet appears.
Save is disabled when the trimmed text is empty.
Same-aisle text edits call updateItem(at:newText:) and persist without unnecessary remove/add churn.
Aisle changes remove the old item first, add the edited item to the target aisle, and persist the rendered markdown.
Unchanged values are treated as a no-op or equivalent non-drifting save path.
